title: Sylvia was so great!
text: Sylvia was so great! We had a fabulous tour. She really customized it for us and she was so incredibly knowledgable! The Picasso Museum was incredible and her explanations and understanding was fantastic. Thank you!

title: Barcelona Private Tour: Sagrada Família, Park Güell & Amazing Paella
text:
Alessandro was an exceptional tour guide and a truly wonderful host. His deep knowledge of Barcelona’s rich history, Antoni Gaudí’s artistic journey, and Spanish culture was both insightful and engaging. It felt like being guided by a professor in the field.

We were seamlessly transported between locations by a Mercedes-Benz chauffeur, allowing us to fully enjoy visits to iconic landmarks such as Sagrada Família, Casa Batlló, and Park Güell.

title: The best way to explore Barcelona Old Town
text: We had an amazing walking tour through the old town of Barcelona! Alessandro was incredibly knowledgeable—not only about the city's rich history, but also about its architecture, archaeology, and hidden corners that most tourists would never find on their own. He shared fascinating stories and lesser-known facts that really brought the city to life. On top of that, he’s super friendly, relaxed, and genuinely cares about making sure everyone has a great experience.
